Check the fixed alarm at control 
 room by I&C engineer or by maintenance request from operation department.

By DCS system information I&C engineer can define the king of problem and 
 which cabinet and which FUM card has the problem

Each FUM card 
has an indication lamp OFF at normal operation.

If the indication lamp of FUM card flash light this means the problem in the 
 field then check the field devices (switches, transmitters, RTD, thermometers 
 ... etc)

If the indication lamp of FUM card fixed light this means the problem in FUM 
 module itself then change the FUM card
